newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Q2 AVERAGE GROSS MONTHLY WAGE UP 21.8 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: Q2 AVERAGE GROSS MONTHLY WAGE UP 21.8 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The average monthly gross wage in Estonia in the second quarter of 1997 was 3,659 kroons, a rise of 21.8 percent compared to the same period a year ago, the statistics office said on Tuesday.
The highest average gross monthly salary was recorded in the financial sector at 7,805 kroons in the second quarter of 1997.
Salaries in the financial sector rose by 24.5 percent over the year.
The biggest increase was in the forest industry, where the average wage rose by 51.6 percent.
The smallest increase was in the hotel and catering sector, where average wages crept up only 6.2 percent over the year.
The average monthly wage in the agricultural and hunting sector was 2,125 kroons and increased by 18.6 percent.
